## Change

Describe the smallest user-visible change and link a related issue when available.

## Evidence

- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior and a negative case.
- [ ] The scoring formula and assumptions are documented when a scenario changes.
- [ ] Reports distinguish observed facts from simulated consequences.
- [ ] Fixtures and screenshots contain no secrets or private repository data.
- [ ] `python -m pytest -q` passes.

## Limitations

List unsupported cases and possible false positives, or write None.
